title: Credit Policy Rate Sheet: Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Score Bands and Contract APR
content:
**Issued by Kestrel Credit Policy for the Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Installment Sale Contract.**

Every Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Installment Sale Contract is booked on one of six credit tiers. A tier admits an applicant whose credit score (FICO Auto Score 8, on the 250 to 900 scale, a whole number) lies between that tier's lowest and highest admitted score, both ends included. The contract APR, in percent to two decimals, is read from the tier's rate sheet for the term band that contains the contract term in months; a band marked "not offered" cannot be booked on that tier.

## Score bands

| Tier | Lowest admitted score | Highest admitted score |
|---|---|---|
| Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Tier 5 | 540 | 589 |
| Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Tier 4 | 590 | 629 |
| Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Tier 3 | 630 | 669 |
| Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Tier 2 | 670 | 699 |
| Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Tier 1 | 700 | 739 |
| Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Tier 1+ | 740 | 900 |

## Contract APR by term band (percent)

| Tier | 24 to 36 months | 37 to 48 months | 49 to 60 months | 61 to 72 months | 73 to 84 months |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Tier 5 | 14.49 | 14.99 | 15.49 | not offered | not offered |
| Tier 4 | 11.99 | 12.49 | 12.99 | 13.74 | not offered |
| Tier 3 | 9.24 | 9.49 | 9.99 | 10.74 | not offered |
| Tier 2 | 7.49 | 7.74 | 7.99 | 8.74 | 9.74 |
| Tier 1 | 6.24 | 6.49 | 6.74 | 7.24 | 7.99 |
| Tier 1+ | 5.49 | 5.74 | 5.99 | 6.49 | 7.24 |

## Reading the sheet

- The bands do not overlap: a score of 629 falls in Tier 4 and a score of 630 in Tier 3; a score of 739 falls in Tier 1 and 740 in Tier 1+.
- Term bands are whole months and both ends belong to the band: a 60-month term reads the 49 to 60 column, a 61-month term the 61 to 72 column.
- A "not offered" cell means the term band is not available on that tier, whatever the score.

*Hypothetical illustration:* an applicant scored at 702 asking for a 66-month term falls in Tier 1 and reads 7.24 percent from the 61 to 72 column; the same term asked by an applicant scored at 560 (Tier 5) cannot be booked, because that column is "not offered" on Tier 5.
